test.name: A plan item that ends at Archion carries the full hand-off
test.description: Issue #2802 (the research-plan half of the hand-off rule, from alpha feedback of 2026-09-22/23): the only source for Katharina Seeger's parents is the Baiersbronn parish register on Archion, a paid site the researcher must open themselves. research-plan's reply must give the parish link (from loc_001, never just the site name), what the register would settle, what to look for, and an offer to walk the researcher through capture and upload. The search-external-sites agent is stubbed: this test grades research-plan's own text.

input.user_message: Make the research plan for q_001 - where would Katharina Seeger's parents be recorded? Tell me what I need to do.

stub_skills.response: Handed over the Archion parish page for Baiersbronn and logged it as an in-flight external_site entry; the plan item stays in_progress until the capture comes back.

judge_context: loc_001 records that the Baiersbronn Protestant registers are on Archion and gives the parish page URL. The plan should target that register.

Because the researcher must open Archion themselves, the reply must carry the hand-off: (1) the parish link itself — the Archion URL from loc_001, not just 'Archion' or the site's home page; (2) what the register would settle — Katharina's parents, from her 1843 baptism entry or the family register; (3) what to look for — the baptism register or Familienregister covering 1843, and the entry for Katharina Seeger; (4) an offer to walk the researcher through capturing the page and uploading it. Bare directions to a site with no link, or no offer, is a fail.
Archion needs a paid pass to view; saying so is correct, not a hedge.
Do not grade whether search-external-sites was spawned: it is stubbed, and planning without executing is a legitimate ending here.
